{
  "dataset_name": "click_prediction_small",

  "schema_generator": "claude-sonnet-4.6",

  "features": [
    {
      "name": "log_impression_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed impression count normalized by training mean log impression, capturing exposure intensity on a smooth scale suitable for linear margins",
      "value_range": [0.0, 3.5],
      "feature_family": "exposure",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Reduces skew in impression distribution, providing smooth continuous signal for SVM hyperplane separation",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(impression) / np.log1p(2.071261682242991)"
    },
    {
      "name": "position_depth_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of ad position to search depth, measuring how prominently the ad appears relative to total depth of results shown",
      "value_range": [0.33, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "placement",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures relative prominence of ad placement; lower ratio indicates better visibility, useful linear feature for SVM",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "position / np.maximum(depth, 1)"
    },
    {
      "name": "top_position_flag",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Binary indicator for whether the ad appears in position 1, the most prominent placement",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "placement",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Direct linear signal for top-position ads which typically have higher engagement rates",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(position == 1, 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "shallow_depth_flag",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Binary indicator for search depth of 1, meaning only one result was shown, indicating high relevance context",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "placement",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures high-relevance search contexts where fewer results are shown, useful binary feature for linear SVM",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(depth == 1, 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "impression_log_sqrt_composite",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Composite of log and sqrt transformations of impression count, providing a smooth severity measure of ad exposure frequency",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "exposure",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Blended transformation reduces extreme outlier influence while preserving monotonic ordering for linear separation",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.log1p(impression) + np.sqrt(impression)) / 2.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "ad_id_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ad ID normalized to [0,1] range using training min/max, serving as a proxy for ad recency or campaign ordering",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "ad_identity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides smooth normalized ad identifier signal that may correlate with ad campaign characteristics",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(ad_id - 1000806.0) / (22226685.0 - 1000806.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "advertiser_id_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Advertiser ID normalized to [0,1] range using training min/max, capturing advertiser ordering as a continuous feature",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "ad_identity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalized advertiser identifier may encode systematic differences in advertiser quality or category for linear models",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(advertiser_id - 82.0) / (39074.0 - 82.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "keyword_log_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-normalized keyword ID capturing keyword space position on a smooth scale, useful as a proxy for keyword category",

      "feature_family": "content",

      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(keyword_id) / np.log1p(1214033.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "content_id_alignment_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Normalized absolute difference between title and description IDs, measuring content component alignment as a coherence proxy",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "content",

      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "1.0 - np.clip(np.abs(np.log1p(title_id) - np.log1p(description_id)) / np.log1p(3970109.0), 0.0, 1.0)"

    {
      "name": "user_id_log_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-normalized user ID providing smooth continuous representation of user space position as a proxy for user segment",

      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(user_id) / np.log1p(23902732.0)"

      "name": "ad_content_diversity_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of ad content diversity based on the spread between keyword, title, and description IDs relative to their respective ranges; higher values indicate more diverse content components which may signal broader targeting",

      "feature_family": "content",

    }
  ]
